snippet.title: Alfred’s Alien Abduction Adventure – Latest Trailer - June 2026
snippet.description:
👽 Alfred’s Alien Abduction Adventure – Official Trailer

🎮 Wishlist on Steam & Play the Demo:
👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/4065580/Alfreds_Alien_Abduction_Adventure/

Built with the Godot, Alfred’s Alien Abduction Adventure is a sci-fi horror experience where you wake up on an alien spacecraft with no memory… which is already a bad start.

Explore a strange and unsettling environment, solve puzzles, and try to figure out what’s going on — all while dealing with the small inconvenience of being abducted by aliens.

You are not alone.
They know you’re there.
They probably put you there.

🛸 Features:

Atmospheric alien environments
Puzzle-driven gameplay
Immersive UI and interactions
Occasional moments of “what was that?!”

🗓️ Targeting release toward the end of June
🎪 Hoping to feature in Steam Next Fest

⚠️ Still in development — bugs may exist, aliens may or may not be responsible.

If this looks like your kind of nightmare, consider wishlisting and following development 👇
